purpose: Exploratory puck concept renders; dimensions, diffusion, and electronics fit are not validated.

prompts.name: 01-slim-halo
prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create a photorealistic industrial design concept render of a compact DIY-friendly desktop electronics puck, suitable for a premium but realistically FDM 3D printed enclosure. This is a product concept, not production CAD.
Subject: a small circular low cylinder approximately 60 mm diameter and 18 mm tall. Simple flat matte charcoal PLA top with gently chamfered outer edge; matching charcoal lower shell; a continuous 3 mm tall translucent frosted natural PLA diffuser band runs all the way around the outer sidewall just below the top edge. The illuminated band must be visibly translucent printed plastic with subtle fine horizontal print layers, broad soft cyan light transmission and believable slight nonuniformity, not a neon tube, glass, polished acrylic or exposed LED dots. Opaque top, opaque bottom. Compact, understated, quietly premium, easily printable geometry. One small correctly scaled USB-C socket in the rear side of the opaque lower shell, visible on the rear three-quarter view, no plug or cable. No display, branding, knob, extra controls, vents or decorative screws on top. A slim dark rubber foot underneath.
Composition: landscape studio product design sheet, very light warm gray seamless background. Large front three-quarter hero view on left, smaller rear three-quarter view of the same exact puck on right showing the USB-C port. Both show the same shape, diffuser placement and proportions. Plenty of breathing space, realistic soft contact shadows, orthographic-like 70 mm product camera, all parts sharp. Gentle studio lighting with restrained cyan spill on the surface. The puck should look small and tangible, not a room-sized appliance.
Only text: small tasteful sans serif caption at lower left exactly "01 / SLIM HALO", and below it "Approx. 60 × 18 mm · Concept". No other text, labels, watermarks, logos, annotations or technical dimensions.

prompts.name: 02-soft-rim
prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create a photorealistic industrial design concept render of a compact DIY-friendly desktop electronics puck, realistically made with FDM 3D printed parts. This is an exploratory product concept, not production CAD.
Subject: small circular puck approximately 60 mm diameter and 21 mm tall. Warm off-white matte PLA opaque flat top disk with generous rounded edge and matching off-white opaque base. The distinguishing feature is a continuous 4 mm wide frosted translucent natural PLA ring wrapping around the outer shoulder: light is visible both from above and from the side, a softly rounded luminous rim between opaque top and lower body. The center of the top must remain opaque, flat and solid. Diffuser is milky translucent PRINTED PLA with subtle fine layer lines and softly transmitted warm-white LED light, believable mild light variation; no individual LED hotspots, no clear glass, neon tubes or polished acrylic. Simple printable geometry with soft radii and tidy seams, understated everyday desk accessory. One accurately scaled USB-C socket at rear in opaque lower body. Thin dark nonslip foot. No screen, logo, dial, vents or top controls.
Composition: landscape studio design sheet on light warm gray seamless background. Large front three-quarter view at left, smaller rear three-quarter view of same puck at right revealing USB-C. Consistent shape and proportions between both views. Realistic soft studio illumination, subtle warm light spill, crisp material detail, soft contact shadows, 70 mm product photography. Keep device low and small.
Only text: small restrained sans serif caption at bottom left exactly "02 / SOFT RIM" and below it "Approx. 60 × 21 mm · Concept". No other text or watermarks.

prompts.name: 03-construction-study
prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Input image 1 is a design reference for the SLIM HALO puck already created. Preserve its circular flat charcoal PLA top, charcoal lower shell, thin cyan-lit frosted PLA perimeter band just below the lid, rear USB-C connection, small proportions and realistic FDM printed finish.
Create a new industrial design construction-study image of that same product. Landscape canvas with a clean very light warm-gray studio background. At left, show one assembled front three-quarter hero view matching the reference. At right, show a larger coherent exploded three-quarter view of the SAME design, with components vertically aligned on one assembly axis and separated by modest gaps: (1) opaque flat charcoal top cap, (2) a separate thin-walled hollow annular frosted natural PLA light diffuser, (3) an illustrative compact LED perimeter carrier inside the annulus with a small rectangular ESP32-style controller board positioned toward the rear so its USB-C socket can reach the rear enclosure opening, (4) shallow opaque charcoal lower enclosure with locating features and a thin nonslip foot. The light diffuser must be an open ring, not a solid disk. A few simple short wires can connect controller and LEDs; tidy and plausible, no giant motherboard, no batteries, no fan, no screen, no antenna protrusion. The electronics are clearly illustrative layout placeholders, not a claim to a verified PCB design. Show natural milky translucence and fine print-layer texture; subdued cyan illumination only on the assembled product. The exploded diffuser is unlit. All layers fit within the same approximately 60 mm circular footprint; assembled height approximately 18 mm, dimensions tentative.
Use restrained fine leaders and exactly these four short part labels: "Opaque lid", "Printed PLA diffuser", "LEDs + controller", "Printed base". Keep labels legible and well separated from the objects.
Only other text, small at lower left: "03 / CONSTRUCTION STUDY" and below it "Illustrative internals · Fit to be verified".
Elegant studio product rendering, soft contact shadows, material realism, technically plausible simplified construction, no patent-style drawing, no watermarks, no additional logos or text.
